name: Batch Auditor
description: Read-only readiness check for a 911 or 922 batch. Verifies the batch is complete before the floor (orders & prints, LST, run time, forming, pallets, kitting) and presents the results as a dashboard in the console.
author: Anthony Sieben

setup: Sync the 911 and/or 922 folders. Know the batch line you want to check - the audit is read-only and changes nothing.
how_it_works: Pick the batch. The app checks each readiness item - orders & prints, LST, run time, forming, pallets, kitting - for a 911 or 922 batch.
It renders the results as a dashboard of KPI cards and charts plus a text summary.
output: A readiness dashboard and summary showing which steps are done and what's still missing, before the batch hits the floor.
